Sandbox_BSH_HearingMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the radius of every valid world sound when deciding which zombies hear it.
Sandbox_BSH_MinSoundRadius_tooltip: Sounds with a base radius below this value (in tiles) are ignored by blind zombies.
Sandbox_BSH_Strength_tooltip: Strength applied to every zombie when its stats are initialized or its speed changes.
Sandbox_BSH_SprintOnSound_tooltip: When on, alerted zombies sprint toward the sound. When off, they only walk toward it at walking speed.
Sandbox_BSH_AlertMemorySeconds_tooltip: How long an alerted zombie keeps moving toward a sound before giving up and shambling again.
Sandbox_BSH_SilenceSeconds_tooltip: In tactile combat, the player must be farther than 1.8 tiles and make no sound for this long for the zombie to lose them.
